name: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
summary: Numerical solution of the flow equations for aerospace design: discretisation, meshing, solvers, turbulence modelling and verification.

topics.name: Hierarchy of flow models: potential, Euler, RANS, LES, DNS
Consistency, stability (CFL, von Neumann) and convergence
Upwind schemes, flux-vector splitting and Riemann solvers
Shock capturing, limiters and TVD schemes
Time integration: explicit, implicit and dual time stepping
Mesh generation: structured, unstructured, overset and adaptive meshes
Boundary conditions for external and internal flows
Turbulence modelling in RANS; hybrid RANS-LES
Verification and validation; grid convergence studies
Adjoint methods for aerodynamic shape optimisation
Practical CFD workflow with OpenFOAM, SU2 or commercial codes
